jobs.title: Vice-President, Information Management & Information Technology
jobs.description:
Unit | Department:
Corporate Services | Technology

Reports to:
Executive Vice-President, Corporate Services and CFO

Type:
Permanent | 1 Vacancy (with multiple location options)

As one of the country’s most influential national health organizations, the Canadian Medical Association (CMA) plays a central role in shaping the future of health care in Canada. The CMA unites physicians across the country, advocates for system transformation and champions the public interest. As the organization advances its enterprise priorities, it is strengthening the information management, technology, cybersecurity and AI capabilities that enable our mission and support our people.

Reporting to the Executive Vice-President, Corporate Services and CFO, the Vice-President, Information Management and Information Technology (IM/IT) provides enterprise-wide leadership, governance and oversight for information management, technology, AI and cybersecurity across the CMA. A highly engaged and collaborative leader, they will align IM/IT investments, platforms and practices with organizational strategy, enterprise architecture, risk requirements and approved priorities.

The Vice-President will develop an integrated enterprise information management and technology strategy, operating model and roadmap, and establish clear decision rights, standards and governance for technology, information management, cybersecurity, data architecture and AI. Working closely with the Executive Leadership Team, relevant governance bodies and business leaders at the CMA, they will provide strategic counsel on opportunities, investments, dependencies and risks, while ensuring clear reporting on performance and value realization.

This role is accountable for enterprise information management, including data governance, architecture, enterprise information platforms, analytics capabilities, and responsible AI governance, adoption and enablement. The Vice-President will also direct reliable technology operations and service delivery across cybersecurity, cloud and network infrastructure, identity and access management, enterprise applications, collaboration platforms, integrations, backup, disaster recovery and business continuity. They will oversee operating budgets, technology lifecycle planning, vendors and contracts, and hold delivery partners accountable for service, project and risk outcomes.

The Vice-President will lead the transformation and modernization of the IM/IT operating model, enhance operational planning, portfolio management and delivery disciplines, and strengthen the capabilities and capacity required to meet evolving enterprise needs. Working in close partnership with business leaders, they will ensure priorities and trade-offs are transparent, demand is aligned with organizational capacity, and investments deliver practical and measurable value. They will balance reliable day-to-day operations with longer-term modernization, build the internal capabilities and cross-enterprise partnerships required for the future, and reinforce disciplined execution, project governance and benefits realization.

The Vice-President, IM/IT will be a visible, compelling and highly engaged leader who brings energy, optimism and momentum to a team navigating significant change. They will establish trust and stability, communicate frequently and authentically, create a strong sense of shared purpose, and actively reconnect and motivate employees. Through an accessible and hands-on leadership style, they will set clear direction, recognize contributions, develop leaders and capability, and foster the confidence, cohesion and accountability needed for the team to succeed.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned IM/IT executive with significant senior leadership experience and enterprise-wide accountability in a complex, dynamic organization. They bring demonstrated success developing and implementing IM/IT strategies, overseeing cybersecurity for a multi-faceted organization and leading multidisciplinary teams through transformation and uncertainty. They are a visible, energetic and credible people leader with a track record of rebuilding trust, strengthening engagement and creating clarity, confidence and momentum. With strong business acumen, an enterprise perspective and sufficient technical breadth to provide credible enterprise leadership, the successful candidate will make complex information clear, influence senior audiences, build alignment and move from strategy to measurable results.

This is a significant opportunity to shape the secure, scalable and data-enabled foundation of a national association, strengthening the CMA’s capabilities and supporting its long-term impact.

If you are interested in this senior leadership opportunity, please apply directly online to formalize your candidacy.

The CMA and the CMA Group of Companies (CMA Foundation and CMA Impact) are committed to accommodating employees with disabilities, accessibility needs, and other protected human rights characteristics, to the point of undue hardship. Any candidate requiring accommodation is encouraged to make their needs known.

Reconciliation, equity, diversity, and inclusion are key priorities, and the CMA enterprise actively strives to build a culture where all employees can be their authentic selves and are valued for their diverse personal experiences and perspectives. We welcome and encourage candidates from diverse backgrounds and a variety of lived experiences to apply.

jobs.title: Director of GTM Data, Processes, and AI Enablement
jobs.description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform
for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers
, including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining
Autodesk Operations Solutions
, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations.
Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

The Role

MaintainX (part of Autodesk) is hiring a Director of GTM Data, Processes, and AI Enablement to own critical foundations of our GTM teams, including:

Customer and prospect data within our CRM;
Core CRM processes that enable selling across GTM teams (e.g., opportunity workflows, territory assignment processes); and
Our internal GenAI and automation efforts driving efficiency, effectiveness, and productivity of our GTM teams

This role also owns the integration of the MaintainX GTM teams into Autodesk GTM systems, processes, and GTM motions, for the core functional areas of the role – a key area of focus for the next 6 to 18 months.

The role sits in the broader MaintainX Revenue Strategy and Operations team and leads a small team of data quality analysts, but we expect this role to drive the majority of its impact through others outside of their direct team. Across all functional areas, this role will be working with, influencing, and directing the work of senior stakeholders, front-line managers, and ICs across Marketing, Rev Ops, Enablement, and GTM Engineering. We need someone with deep functional expertise that knows best practices and has rapid pattern recognition for solutions to GTM issues, who is technical enough to be credible with engineers, and is practical enough to be trusted by sellers to get work done.

What You'll Do

Own CRM data quality and governance

Set the strategy, standards, and governance for leads, contacts, accounts, and account hierarchies. That includes parent/child structures, holding companies, franchises, PE portfolios, and multi-site customers.
Move data quality from cleanup to prevention. Put in intake controls, matching and dedupe rules, and enrichment precedence, and track them on a data quality scorecard with targets.
Show leadership what data gaps cost in revenue, and make GTM data ready for AI use cases.
Lead the team doing this work, including writing requirements for GTM Systems to implement.
Develop deduplication strategies and processes to manage a dual CRM environment across MaintainX and Autodesk

Drive core CRM-based processes and workflows

Own CRM territory management developing the processes and systems requirements to implement the territory design and strategy defined by GTM leadership and Rev Ops teams.
Own our rules of engagement: account ownership, crediting, and conflict resolution across segments, regions, and teams – including both MaintainX selling in isolation and coordination between MaintainX and Autodesk sellers
Own optimization of CRM processes and workflows for end user teams, including building an understanding of current processes, identifying points of improvement, working with GTM systems and Rev Ops teams to define business requirements
Collaborate with Rev Ops, Enablement, and GTM systems teams to ensure field teams know how to use our systems and processes as they change, through release communications, training, and documentation.

Lead the GTM AI program for field teams

Run out GenAI and automation program for GTM field teams end to end: intake, prioritization and resource allocation across GTM and Engineering, operating cadences, solution evaluation, executive readouts, field enablement.
Lead discovery with Sales leaders to find the highest-value automation and agent opportunities. Align leadership and our GTM engineering team on one prioritized roadmap.
Own business requirements, build-vs-buy recommendations, and testing for centrally built solutions. Partner with Engineering to build and launch them.
Set the standards for how teams build their own solutions: knowledge base governance, a quality bar, and a path for scaling proven team-built tools across the org.
Own rollout with Enablement and measure adoption and ROI. The measure is workflows changed, not trainings delivered.

Lead integration efforts for MaintainX GTM into Autodesk

Own the GTM integration plan, governance and coordination across the workstreams, including: systems and data, account mapping and ownership, territories, sales process alignment, rules of engagement for joint selling, and enablement.
Coordinate stakeholders across both organizations. Run the cadence, track risks and dependencies, and escalate decisions.
Be accountable for integration outcomes, not just coordination.

About You

10+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM strategy at a B2B SaaS company, including 3+ years leading people.
Deep expertise in core sales processes, territory design, and rules of engagement.
Strong command of the CRM data model: Salesforce objects, account hierarchies, matching, and enrichment. You define and specify; you don't need to configure.
Hands-on experience bringing AI into GTM workflows (LLMs, agents, workflow automation), with results you can measure. Fluent enough to work credibly with engineers.
A track record of leading large cross-functional programs through influence, including with VP and C-level leaders.
M&A or GTM integration experience is strongly preferred.
Clear writing and speaking. You can make complex tradeoffs understandable to sellers, engineers, and executives.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running.
Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits.
Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging.
We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

jobs.title: Director Threat Intelligence
jobs.description:
Division:  Technology

Location:  Toronto, Winnipeg

IGM Financial Inc. is a leading wealth and asset management company in Canada, managing approximately $310 billion in assets as of December 31, 2025. It offers financial planning and investment services to over two million Canadians through IG Wealth Management and Mackenzie Investments.

Founded in 1926, IG Wealth Management is a key part of IGM's business model, providing comprehensive wealth management services to Canadian financial advisors and their clients.

With a vision to inspire financial confidence, IG Wealth Management is recognized as one of Manitoba’s Top Employers, Canada’s Top 100 Employers, and Best Diversity Employers, aiming to innovate the industry and support Canadians in achieving their financial goals.

Join our team to engage in continuous learning and skill development in a supportive environment. Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work environment, where you spend three days a week in the office, connecting, collaborating, and enjoying quality time with your amazing colleagues! Our Values: Be better; we strive for improvement in everything we do. Be accountable; we foster clarity and are empowered to act responsibly. Be a team; we are united to drive collective impact to achieve our goals.

Overall Job Purpose

Accountable for enterprise strategy, standards, and guardrails across security platform and infrastructure engineering, with a direct mandate to mature Threat Intelligence and DevSecOps as day to day operating capabilities. Shapes policy enforcement, resolves systemic constraints across multiple teams, and influences senior stakeholders on investment, resilience, and risk trade-offs, translating enterprise considerations into actionable governance aligned to Technology standards.

Key Accountabilities

Enterprise Strategy, Standards, and Guardrails
Define and evolve enterprise platform and infrastructure standards spanning tooling, pipelines, shared services, automation, resilience, recoverability, and observability, and drive adoption across portfolios.
Serve as trusted advisor on the highest-complexity platform, infrastructure, and operational resilience issues across multiple teams.
Threat Intelligence Enablement
Own the enterprise standards for threat intelligence collection, enrichment, and dissemination so that intel drives compensating control recommendations for operators.
Translate threat intelligence into prioritized, evidence-based guardrails and detection requirements across the security ecosystem.
DevSecOps and Secure Delivery
Sponsor policy-as-code, automation, and knowledge automation practices so security controls are codified, machine-testable, and enforced within pipelines.
Define safe automation and CI/CD enablement patterns that embed security guardrails into build, test, deploy, and operate workflows.
Systemic Constraint Resolution
Resolve systemic platform and infrastructure constraints impacting delivery speed, reliability, security, capacity, stability, or recoverability across multiple teams.
Resilience, Incident, and Operational Readiness
Drive observability, resilience, and incident learning at enterprise scale, including telemetry, alerting, capacity, and DR readiness, to improve service maturity.
Influence, Investment, and Escalation Governance
Influence roadmap and investment decisions with evidence-based trade-offs on capability, risk, resilience, cost, and scalability.
Determine when initiatives require escalation due to enterprise or regulatory impact and ensure consistent engagement with architecture and risk forums.
Partner with senior stakeholders to align priorities and sequencing when constraints materially impact outcomes.
AI-Enabled Practices
Shape and sponsor AI-enabled platform and infrastructure strategy, including automation, predictive monitoring, and policy-as-code, aligned to security and governance.
People and Capability Uplift
Mentor senior ICs and strengthen capability uplift through communities of practice and standards forums.
Continuous Improvement
Identify recurring friction and enable durable fixes across the platform and infrastructure ecosystem.

Qualifications

Post-secondary education in Technology or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Extensive progressive experience delivering enterprise platform and infrastructure services and enablement.
Proven influence on standards, governance alignment, and risk-informed decisions across multiple teams.
Demonstrated leadership-by-influence with senior stakeholders and governance forums.
Deep expertise in automation, CI/CD enablement, observability, recoverability, and secure operations.
Ability to shape AI-enabled strategy and guardrails at scale.
Demonstrated depth in Threat Intelligence and DevSecOps as core operating disciplines.

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $149,500 - $192,500
which is determined based on skills, knowledge and experience and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for annual short-term incentive, health and well-being benefits, retirement and savings plan, paid time off and career development.

Benefits

COMPETITIVE COMPENSATION & RECOGNITION: competitive base salary, performance-weighted bonus, education/career support, option to join Employee Share Purchase Plan with employer matching component.
EMPLOYEE BENEFITS & INSURANCE: competitive health and dental coverage, flexible plan for you and your family and short-term & long-term disability plans.
RETIREMENT SAVINGS PROGRAMS: voluntary Defined Contribution Pension Plan
WORK LIFE BALANCE: paid volunteer days, competitive time off, including 10 wellness days off, WorkPerks discount program, hybrid & flex work arrangements.
INCLUSIVE CULTURE AND DIVERSITY: living our core values: Be a Team, Be Accountable, Be Better, engaging with community through Business Resource Groups (BRG communities are volunteer employee-led groups formed around a common interest, identity, or background).

IGM is a diverse workplace committed to doing business inclusively - this starts with having a representative workforce! We encourage applications from all qualified candidates that represent the diversity present across Canada – including racialized persons, women, Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, 2SLGBTQIA+ community, gender diverse and neurodiverse individuals, as well as all who may contribute to the further diversification of ideas.

IG is an accessible employer committed to providing a barrier- free recruitment experience. If you require an accommodation or this information in an alternate format at any stage of the recruitment process, please reach out to the Talent Acquisition team who will work with you to meet your needs.

How to Apply: Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and a cover letter detailing their qualifications and experience to https://www.ig.ca/en/careers

Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment: As part of our Talent Acquisition process, we may use artificial intelligence and automated tools to support activities such as candidate sourcing, application review, and interview scheduling. These tools support the recruitment process; all hiring decisions are made by people.

We thank all applicants for their interest in IG Wealth Management; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Please apply before October 18 2026.

jobs.description:
The Director, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) leads enterprise budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, and decision support. This role partners with senior leadership and business units to align financial and operational realities, provide proactive insights, and drive performance. The Director manages a high-performing FP&A team and ensures disciplined governance, clear executive reporting, and continuous improvement, leveraging strong analytics and modeling.

What we offer (and why you’ll love it here!):

Epic Work-Life Balance: Flexible remote work options because we value your time and well-being.
Growth Opportunities: Committed to fostering a culture of growth, where every team member is encouraged to pursue new skills, expand their knowledge, and advance their careers.
Vibrant Culture: Over 1,500 team members across Canada and year over year we manage to maintain an overall above industry engagement score by using a monthly pulse survey.
Attractive Compensation: Competitive salary, incentive program, and comprehensive benefits package.
What & Where: Full-Time, Permanent & Moncton, NB or Oakville, ON

Why BioScript Solutions?

At BioScript, we're not just a company—we're a fast-growing company always putting patients first. Recognized as one of Canada’s Best Managed Companies, we believe in pushing boundaries, setting trends, and creating meaningful experiences that captivate and inspire. Our vibrant team is made up of innovative minds who are passionate about driving success and making an impact. Ready to be a part of this exhilarating journey?

Your Mission

Budgeting & Forecasting

Lead the annual budgeting process and short and long-term financial forecasting to support business strategy and advise senior leaders on financial implications of strategic choices.
Coordinate cross-functional inputs to ensure realistic plans, aligned assumptions, and accountability for outcomes.

Management Reporting & Insights

Establish and monitor financial and operational KPIs, ensuring robust analytics to assess progress, profitability, and efficiency.
Chair senior management meetings, coordinating the preparation, consolidation, and presentation of reporting packages, including financial results, KPIs, and related commentary.
Oversee the provision of monthly results and interpretations to business units to support achievement of departmental goals.
Develop, implement, monitor, and continually improve management reporting to keep pace with structural changes and growth.
Leverage analytics and modeling to interpret results and articulate clear, actionable recommendations.
Review performance versus plan/forecast, identify significant variances, and drive corrective actions.

Business Partnering

Collaborate with senior management to ensure operational and financial realities are aligned.
Challenge business units through proactive insights and the identification of opportunities to improve growth, margin, productivity, and cash performance.
Support key business decisions and initiatives with data-driven analysis and clear financial implications.

Scenario & Investment Analysis

Direct scenario and sensitivity analyses for strategic decisions, investments, and resource allocation.
Evaluate trade-offs and risk/return dynamics; synthesize recommendations for executive decision-making.

Governance & Controls

Partner with Accounting to align on accounting policies, close calendars, and reconciliation of actuals to plans/forecasts.
Maintain disciplined methodologies for budgeting, forecasting, KPI definitions, and variance analysis.

Board & Executive Reporting

Prepare executive and board-level materials with clear insights, risks, opportunities, and recommendations.
Craft concise narratives and visuals that translate complex financials into strategic implications for decision-makers.
Coordinate timelines and inputs to ensure accurate, timely delivery of all board/executive reporting packages.

Leadership Responsibilities

Provides clear direction, sets measurable goals, and holds team members accountable for performance and results.
Coaches, develops, and supports team members through regular feedback, performance reviews, and career development planning.
Fosters a high-performing, inclusive team culture that aligns with company values and business objectives.

Education

What You Bring to the Table:

Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance or related field.
CPA designation required.

Experience

Minimum of 10 years’ financial and team management experience.

Skills

Strong business acumen with clear understanding of industry trends, able to think strategically.
Advanced financial modeling, forecasting, and budgeting capabilities.
Strong analytical mindset and communication skills; adept at presenting complex financial concepts to non-financial stakeholders.
Impeccable attention to detail.
Extensive experience leading budgeting and forecasting for mid-to-large sized organizations.
Strong background in management reporting, budgeting and analytics.
Experience partnering with and influencing senior executives and divisional leaders.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Works effectively in teams.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple deadlines and competing priorities.
Results-oriented and process-driven.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
English proficiency is required for this position to effectively communicate with internal and external stakeholders.

Compensation:
At BioScript, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package and is determined within a range. Our pay ranges are based on the local cost of labor benchmarks for each specific role, level, and geographic location.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Vice President Finance

Osborne Financial Search has been retained by a large, privately held industrial manufacturing and processing business to recruit a Vice President, Finance
.

The company operates across Canada and the U.S. and has experienced significant growth over the past several years. With that growth has come increased complexity across the business and a need to continue building the finance infrastructure, systems and processes required to support the organization going forward.

Reporting directly to the CFO, the VP Finance will lead the day-to-day finance function and work closely with senior leadership and operations across the business. The mandate is broad, with responsibility for financial leadership, planning and analysis, reporting, treasury and banking, systems and process improvement, and development of the finance team.

A significant priority will be the transformation of the finance function, including implementation of a new ERP and greater automation of processes and reporting. The successful candidate will be expected to understand how the business operates, identify where finance can work more effectively and lead those improvements through execution.

Roles & Responsibilities

• Lead the day-to-day finance function and provide leadership and direction to the broader finance team.

• Strengthen FP&A and business partnering capabilities, working closely with operational and senior leaders to improve financial visibility and decision-making.
• Oversee consolidated financial reporting across multiple entities and jurisdictions, including IFRS and U.S. GAAP requirements.
• Lead the implementation of a new ERP and drive improvements in finance processes, systems, reporting and automation.
• Identify opportunities to simplify manual processes, improve efficiency and reduce reliance on spreadsheets across the finance organization.
• Provide oversight and leadership across treasury, cash management, banking relationships and the company’s broader financing requirements.
• Support the CFO on corporate finance initiatives, including banking, financing, M&A and other strategic priorities.
• Ensure appropriate financial controls, policies and processes are in place to support a growing and increasingly complex organization.
• Build the capabilities of the finance team, establish clear accountabilities and develop a function capable of supporting the continued growth of the business.
• Develop strong relationships across the organization and ensure finance is providing practical, timely information to support operational and strategic decision-making.

What We’re Looking For

The successful candidate will be a CPA with significant progressive finance leadership experience in a complex operating environment.

Compensation: $160,000 - $200,000

Location: 335 Steelcase Rd East, Markham, ON (In Office)

About The Opportunity

SinaLite and Willowpack are looking for a Senior Director of Finance to join our leadership team and take ownership of the financial strategy, discipline, and decision support required to support two growing manufacturing businesses.

This is a hands-on senior leadership role for an experienced finance professional who understands that strong finance leadership goes well beyond reporting the numbers. You will help shape business decisions by bringing greater visibility and discipline to cash, working capital, manufacturing costs, margins, investments, and financial risk.

SinaLite is an established wholesale printing business focused on protecting and expanding margins, while Willowpack is a rapidly growing packaging manufacturer requiring disciplined management of capital, working capital, and costs as it scales.

We're looking for a skeptical, analytical, and commercially minded finance leader who is comfortable challenging assumptions, getting into the details, developing a strong finance team, and giving leadership the financial clarity needed to make better decisions.

For the right individual, this role offers a clear opportunity to grow into a VP-level position within approximately two years.

What You'll Be Responsible For

Cash, Liquidity & Working Capital

Build and own a rolling 13-week cash forecast and longer-term liquidity models.
Develop, measure, and report key working-capital metrics, including DPO, DIO, DSO, and the cash conversion cycle.
Partner with Operations, Sourcing, and the Controller to improve inventory, receivables, and payables performance.
Model the cash and working-capital impact of business growth and changing operating conditions.
Manage banking and lender relationships, credit facilities, and lease obligations.

Manufacturing Costing & Margin Management

Develop and maintain accurate job, product, and SKU-level costing across our manufacturing operations.
Ensure costing accurately reflects materials, labour, yield, scrap, and other production costs.
Partner with Sales to establish pricing guardrails, cost-based pricing floors, and margin expectations.
Provide clear financial reporting that allows leadership to understand the economics and performance of SinaLite and Willowpack independently.

FP&A & Strategic Decision Support

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning.
Translate strategic objectives into measurable financial targets and forecasts.
Develop forward-looking, probability-weighted risk and opportunity assessments covering both profitability and cash.
Build financial business cases for capital expenditures, investments, and major strategic decisions.
Track investment performance and returns following implementation.
Provide leadership with scenario modelling and data-driven recommendations to support major business decisions.

Compliance, Controls & Government Funding

Oversee government funding opportunities, including applications, claims, compliance, and reporting.
Ensure compliance with applicable Canadian and U.S. tax, regulatory, and financial reporting requirements.
Strengthen internal financial controls, policies, and procedures appropriate for a growing manufacturing organization.

Finance Team Leadership

Assess the existing finance structure and identify opportunities to strengthen capabilities.
Recruit, coach, and develop finance and FP&A talent.
Ensure team members are positioned effectively across controllership, treasury, and FP&A responsibilities.
Build greater financial accountability across the organization.
Help operational and functional leaders understand the financial impact of their decisions.

Systems, Data & AI

Maximize the value of NetSuite and our broader financial reporting systems.
Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting and financial analysis.
Use AI, analytics, and emerging technologies to improve the speed and quality of financial insights.
Champion a data-driven approach to decision-making throughout the organization.

Qualifications

CPA designation required.
10+ years of progressive finance experience, including at least 5 years in senior financial leadership within a manufacturing environment.
Strong manufacturing cost accounting experience, including job/product costing, inventory, material yield, and scrap.
Proven experience managing cash and working capital through periods of rapid business growth.
Strong FP&A, forecasting, scenario modelling, and financial modelling capabilities.
Experience evaluating capital expenditures and developing investment business cases.
Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and lead high-performing finance teams.
Experience working within an entrepreneurial, privately held, or founder-led organization.
Experience within printing, packaging, converting, or a related manufacturing industry is a strong asset.

What We're Looking For

The Right Person For This Role Is Someone Who

Challenges assumptions — You don't accept a number simply because it was presented to you. You validate it, understand it, and speak up when something doesn't make sense.
Gets into the details — You can operate strategically while still being willing to dig into the numbers when necessary.
Thinks ahead — You identify financial risks and opportunities before they become obvious.
Communicates directly — You can translate complex financial information into clear recommendations for leaders across Finance, Operations, Sales, and other functions.
Takes ownership — You approach decisions with a business-owner mentality, high integrity, and accountability for outcomes.
Builds strong teams — You develop talent, raise expectations, and create a finance function capable of supporting continued growth.
Is comfortable challenging leadership — You have the confidence and executive presence to pressure-test assumptions and provide a different perspective when the numbers support it.

Why Join SinaLite & Willowpack?

This is an opportunity to take on a highly influential finance leadership position across two distinct manufacturing businesses at different stages of growth.

You'll have the opportunity to directly influence how we manage cash, evaluate investments, improve manufacturing margins, scale Willowpack, and make strategic decisions across the organization.

We're also looking for someone who can grow with us. For a high-performing finance leader who demonstrates the ability to operate as a trusted financial partner to the President and leadership team, this role offers a pathway toward VP-level leadership within approximately two years.

If you're a hands-on finance leader who enjoys challenging assumptions, solving complex manufacturing finance problems, building strong teams, and turning financial data into better business decisions, we'd like to hear from you.

Customer and prospect data within our CRM;
Core CRM processes that enable selling across GTM teams (e.g., opportunity workflows, territory assignment processes); and
Our internal GenAI and automation efforts driving efficiency, effectiveness, and productivity of our GTM teams

Run out GenAI and automation program for GTM field teams end to end: intake, prioritization and resource allocation across GTM and Engineering, operating cadences, solution evaluation, executive readouts, field enablement.
Lead discovery with Sales leaders to find the highest-value automation and agent opportunities. Align leadership and our GTM engineering team on one prioritized roadmap.

Own rollout with Enablement and measure adoption and ROI. The measure is workflows changed, not trainings delivered.

new_jobs.description:
Division:  Technology

Location:  Toronto, Winnipeg

IGM Financial Inc. is a leading wealth and asset management company in Canada, managing approximately $310 billion in assets as of December 31, 2025. It offers financial planning and investment services to over two million Canadians through IG Wealth Management and Mackenzie Investments.

Founded in 1926, IG Wealth Management is a key part of IGM's business model, providing comprehensive wealth management services to Canadian financial advisors and their clients.

With a vision to inspire financial confidence, IG Wealth Management is recognized as one of Manitoba’s Top Employers, Canada’s Top 100 Employers, and Best Diversity Employers, aiming to innovate the industry and support Canadians in achieving their financial goals.

Join our team to engage in continuous learning and skill development in a supportive environment. Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work environment, where you spend three days a week in the office, connecting, collaborating, and enjoying quality time with your amazing colleagues! Our Values: Be better; we strive for improvement in everything we do. Be accountable; we foster clarity and are empowered to act responsibly. Be a team; we are united to drive collective impact to achieve our goals.

Overall Job Purpose

Accountable for enterprise strategy, standards, and guardrails across security platform and infrastructure engineering, with a direct mandate to mature Threat Intelligence and DevSecOps as day to day operating capabilities. Shapes policy enforcement, resolves systemic constraints across multiple teams, and influences senior stakeholders on investment, resilience, and risk trade-offs, translating enterprise considerations into actionable governance aligned to Technology standards.

Key Accountabilities

Enterprise Strategy, Standards, and Guardrails
Define and evolve enterprise platform and infrastructure standards spanning tooling, pipelines, shared services, automation, resilience, recoverability, and observability, and drive adoption across portfolios.
Serve as trusted advisor on the highest-complexity platform, infrastructure, and operational resilience issues across multiple teams.
Threat Intelligence Enablement
Own the enterprise standards for threat intelligence collection, enrichment, and dissemination so that intel drives compensating control recommendations for operators.
Translate threat intelligence into prioritized, evidence-based guardrails and detection requirements across the security ecosystem.
DevSecOps and Secure Delivery
Sponsor policy-as-code, automation, and knowledge automation practices so security controls are codified, machine-testable, and enforced within pipelines.
Define safe automation and CI/CD enablement patterns that embed security guardrails into build, test, deploy, and operate workflows.
Systemic Constraint Resolution
Resolve systemic platform and infrastructure constraints impacting delivery speed, reliability, security, capacity, stability, or recoverability across multiple teams.
Resilience, Incident, and Operational Readiness
Drive observability, resilience, and incident learning at enterprise scale, including telemetry, alerting, capacity, and DR readiness, to improve service maturity.
Influence, Investment, and Escalation Governance
Influence roadmap and investment decisions with evidence-based trade-offs on capability, risk, resilience, cost, and scalability.
Determine when initiatives require escalation due to enterprise or regulatory impact and ensure consistent engagement with architecture and risk forums.
Partner with senior stakeholders to align priorities and sequencing when constraints materially impact outcomes.
AI-Enabled Practices
Shape and sponsor AI-enabled platform and infrastructure strategy, including automation, predictive monitoring, and policy-as-code, aligned to security and governance.
People and Capability Uplift
Mentor senior ICs and strengthen capability uplift through communities of practice and standards forums.
Continuous Improvement
Identify recurring friction and enable durable fixes across the platform and infrastructure ecosystem.

Qualifications

Post-secondary education in Technology or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Extensive progressive experience delivering enterprise platform and infrastructure services and enablement.
Proven influence on standards, governance alignment, and risk-informed decisions across multiple teams.
Demonstrated leadership-by-influence with senior stakeholders and governance forums.
Deep expertise in automation, CI/CD enablement, observability, recoverability, and secure operations.
Ability to shape AI-enabled strategy and guardrails at scale.
Demonstrated depth in Threat Intelligence and DevSecOps as core operating disciplines.

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $149,500 - $192,500
which is determined based on skills, knowledge and experience and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for annual short-term incentive, health and well-being benefits, retirement and savings plan, paid time off and career development.

Benefits

COMPETITIVE COMPENSATION & RECOGNITION: competitive base salary, performance-weighted bonus, education/career support, option to join Employee Share Purchase Plan with employer matching component.
EMPLOYEE BENEFITS & INSURANCE: competitive health and dental coverage, flexible plan for you and your family and short-term & long-term disability plans.
RETIREMENT SAVINGS PROGRAMS: voluntary Defined Contribution Pension Plan
WORK LIFE BALANCE: paid volunteer days, competitive time off, including 10 wellness days off, WorkPerks discount program, hybrid & flex work arrangements.
INCLUSIVE CULTURE AND DIVERSITY: living our core values: Be a Team, Be Accountable, Be Better, engaging with community through Business Resource Groups (BRG communities are volunteer employee-led groups formed around a common interest, identity, or background).

IGM is a diverse workplace committed to doing business inclusively - this starts with having a representative workforce! We encourage applications from all qualified candidates that represent the diversity present across Canada – including racialized persons, women, Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, 2SLGBTQIA+ community, gender diverse and neurodiverse individuals, as well as all who may contribute to the further diversification of ideas.

IG is an accessible employer committed to providing a barrier- free recruitment experience. If you require an accommodation or this information in an alternate format at any stage of the recruitment process, please reach out to the Talent Acquisition team who will work with you to meet your needs.

How to Apply: Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and a cover letter detailing their qualifications and experience to https://www.ig.ca/en/careers

Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment: As part of our Talent Acquisition process, we may use artificial intelligence and automated tools to support activities such as candidate sourcing, application review, and interview scheduling. These tools support the recruitment process; all hiring decisions are made by people.

We thank all applicants for their interest in IG Wealth Management; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Please apply before October 18 2026.
